name: Hitozuma Okkake Chikan! ~Neratta Emono wa Nigasanai~
original_name: 人妻追っかけ痴漢！～狙った獲物は逃がさない～
source:
In a crowded train, Kojirou's hand accidentally touches a woman's hip. He is arrested for train molestation, but what saves him is the woman he touched, Shizuka. He now thinks, "She must love me. That's why she saved me...." Since then, Kojirou starts stalking her....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090724004050/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012839]ErogeShop[/url]]
